name: KromiumSecurityConfig
declaration: @ConsistentCopyVisibility data class KromiumSecurityConfig internal constructor(val sandboxEnabled: Boolean, val blockRegistryAndTelemetry: Boolean, val doNotTrack: Boolean, val webrtcIpHandlingPolicy: String?, val authServerAllowlist: List<String>, val authNegotiateDelegateAllowlist: List<String>)
description: Handles security boundaries, privacy headers, WebRTC IP leak prevention, enterprise NTLM/Kerberos authentication allowlists, and background telemetry blocking.
whenToUse: Configure within KromiumConfig.builder().securityConfig { ... } to lock down browser security, protect user privacy, or configure corporate SSO authentication.

properties.name: sandboxEnabled
properties.description: Whether native Chromium sandboxing is enforced.

properties.name: blockRegistryAndTelemetry
properties.description: Whether to block Windows registry touchpoints and outgoing background telemetry (metrics, crash reports).

properties.name: doNotTrack
properties.description: Whether DNT: 1 and Sec-GPC: 1 privacy headers are asserted.

properties.name: webrtcIpHandlingPolicy
properties.description: WebRTC IP handling policy to prevent local/private IP address leaks (e.g. disable_non_proxied_udp).

properties.name: authServerAllowlist
properties.description: Allowlist of servers permitted for integrated HTTP Windows authentication (NTLM/Kerberos).

properties.name: authNegotiateDelegateAllowlist
properties.description: Allowlist of servers to which Kerberos credentials can be delegated.

methods.name: builder
methods.description: Returns a new builder for KromiumSecurityConfig.
